scope: prepared common-functional model; the preparation uses DFT ground references, and this frontend reads no TDA amplitudes or excited-reference energies
seeds: all four promotions from the highest two occupied to lowest two virtual canonical orbitals of the prepared stationary ground
solver: unchanged spin-pure ground-orthogonal ROKS saddle KKT with analytic orbital curvature and local CSF tracking
identity: compare the computed stationary CSFs with already retained OO checkpoints after all four promotions; unique maximum-overlap matching, overlap >=0.95 and energy agreement <1e-5 eV
forbidden: reference excitation energies in state selection
